### Word / Number Details
- **Numeric Value**: (e.g. 175)
- **Current Conversion**: (e.g. நூற்று எழுபத்தைந்து)
- **Proposed Correction**: (e.g. நூற்றெழுபத்தைந்து)

### Reference Corpus Citation
Please cite the reference authority (e.g., Tamil Virtual Academy, BSI Tamil Bible, IRV Tamil, Open-Tamil dictionary, or Winslow / Fabricius Tamil lexicon).

### Sample Scripture Context
Provide the verse reference (e.g., GEN 25:7) and the sentence showing the word in context.
